tools_helpful.evidence: Copied .xaml/.cs/assets, preserved UWP .csproj at .uwp-source/, and mass-rewrote Windows.UI.Xaml -> Microsoft.UI.Xaml; agent started from a clean scaffold.
Iterative native build surfaced each error class in turn; final build SUCCEEDED with 0 errors.

tool_limitations.limitation: Copies legacy Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs (incl. sub-project Tasks/Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs) verbatim; these carry [assembly: AssemblyTitle/Company/Version/...] attributes that SDK-style projects auto-generate, causing CS0579 duplicate-attribute build failures.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: After copy/namespace-rewrite, strip the SDK-auto-generated assembly attribute lines from every copied AssemblyInfo.cs (leave ComVisible/InternalsVisibleTo/Guid intact).

special_apis.special_handling: The WinRT type name equals the app's RootNamespace (ProximitySensor), so unqualified use of the type resolves to the namespace (CS0118). A same-named using-alias also fails (CS0576). Must reference via a DISTINCT alias (e.g. using WdsSensor = Windows.Devices.Sensors.ProximitySensor;) or fully-qualify with global::.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Legacy UWP Tasks\Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs was copied in; SDK-style WinUI csproj auto-generates the same assembly attributes (GenerateAssemblyInfo defaults true), producing duplicates.
errors_encountered.fix: Stripped the assembly attribute lines from Tasks\Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs, leaving only [assembly: ComVisible(false)].

errors_encountered.error: CS0118: 'ProximitySensor' is a namespace but is used like a type (Scenario1..4)
errors_encountered.root_cause: App RootNamespace 'ProximitySensor' shadows the WinRT type Windows.Devices.Sensors.ProximitySensor; unqualified references bind to the namespace.
errors_encountered.fix: Introduced a distinct type alias 'using WdsSensor = Windows.Devices.Sensors.ProximitySensor;' and used WdsSensor at every reference/handler signature.

errors_encountered.error: CS0576: Namespace '<global namespace>' contains a definition conflicting with alias 'ProximitySensor'
errors_encountered.root_cause: Agent first tried to alias with the SAME name: 'using ProximitySensor = Windows.Devices.Sensors.ProximitySensor;', which collides with the project's own ProximitySensor namespace.
errors_encountered.fix: Replaced the same-named alias with a distinct alias name (WdsSensor).

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Fixed CS0118 by adding 'using ProximitySensor = Windows.Devices.Sensors.ProximitySensor;' which then produced CS0576; needed a second edit pass to switch to a distinct alias.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: RootNamespace equals a WinRT type name; a same-named alias cannot resolve the collision.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A migration-patterns entry documenting the RootNamespace-vs-WinRT-type collision (CS0118/CS0576) with the distinct-alias / global:: fix.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Build failed with CS0579 duplicate-attribute after all code compiled; agent had to locate and hand-edit Tasks\Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Legacy AssemblyInfo.cs copied into an SDK-style project that auto-generates the same attributes.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 neutralizing copied AssemblyInfo.cs (Tier-1), plus a patterns entry for CS0579.

env_issues.issue: WinUI pixel screenshots blank and UWP per-scenario UIA/mouse actuation unavailable on the headless measurement host.
env_issues.workaround: Scoring used UIA tree dumps + source comparison; not a migration defect.
